title: Composer Environment Rollback Targets
summary: Cloud Composer environments now expose `imageVersionRollbackTargets` in `SoftwareConfig`, providing insights into available rollback points and their last active usage.
details: The `SoftwareConfig` schema now includes a new `imageVersionRollbackTargets` array. This array contains `ImageVersionRollbackTarget` objects, each detailing an `imageVersion` and its `lastActiveTime`. These new fields are `Output only`, providing valuable insights into available rollback points for your Composer environments. The API change is marked as breaking because these newly introduced properties (`imageVersion` and `lastActiveTime` within `ImageVersionRollbackTarget`, and `imageVersionRollbackTargets` itself) are explicitly defined as `readOnly`. Developers should ensure their clients do not attempt to set values for these properties, as such attempts will now fail.
